description: Celestial X is tackling the "Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS" challenge. Led by a Data Engineer, we are building an automated ETL pipeline to ingest NASA FIRMS data, resolve spatial mismatches, and output a deduplicated fire calendar. The backend is planned. We need: 1) Frontend/Viz Dev (React/Mapbox) 2) Geospatial Data Scientist (Python) 3) UI/UX Designer. Join us!
